title: Interconnectedness of the Paramitas
speaker: Junka Ken Oates
summary: The talk's main teaching is that our tendency to categorize and separate concepts can actually be a hindrance to understanding the interconnectedness of reality, particularly in Buddhist philosophy. Junka Ken Oates suggests that instead of listing individual practices like patience or precepts as separate entities, we should recognize how they are all interdependent and empty of inherent existence. By embracing this understanding, we can cultivate greater mindfulness and wisdom by revisiting our own struggles with qualities like laziness, anger, and patience, and integrating them into a more holistic practice.
